claims.quote: CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD) is a rare developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.
Ganaxolone, a neuroactive steroid, reduces the frequency of major motor seizures in children with CDD.
Along with better seizure control, children who received ganaxolone had improved behavioural scores in select domains compared to placebo.

After 17 weeks of treatment, Manic/Hyperactive scores (mean difference 1.27, 95%CI -2.38,-0.16) and Compulsive Behaviour scores (mean difference 0.58, 95%CI -1.14,-0.01) were lower (improved) in the ganaxolone group compared with the placebo group.
